name: Komorebi Cabins
description: Komorebi Cabins is a calm, serene WordPress block theme designed for a self-catering forest cabin retreat of twelve timber cabins nestled among cedar and beech trees. Featuring a split header, gutter tagline hero, overlapping canopy mosaics, and plan comparison layouts, it provides a quiet documentary aesthetic inspired by forest hospitality. Built for full site editing with refined typography, muted woodland tones, and streamlined reservation request templates.

fonts.role: display: headings, numerals, nav, vertical tagline (variable 400-700, roman and italic, Latin)
